description.value: Wild Ambition is a craft microbrewery and tasting room in Kelowna, operating since December 2018. The tasting room doubles as a retail alcohol outlet, meaning visitors can sample on-site and purchase packaged beer to go. It is an air-conditioned indoor venue — a welcome stop for cyclists navigating the Okanagan in summer heat.
